breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user's mention of using the polar second moment of area (J) was incorrect for this beam bending problem. The generated specification explicitly instructs to use the correct formula κ = M/(EI) and even adds a note explaining why the user's suggestion was disregarded, thus aligning with the ground truth which omits the incorrect instruction entirely.
